Lecture series tracked on this site. Each course is independent — add another anytime without restructuring the whole project.

## Active

### [Mathematical Foundations of Machine Learning](mfml/index.qmd)

- **ID:** `mfml`
- **Instructor:** Prof. Prathosh A.P. (IISc)
- **Platform:** NPTEL
- **Focus:** Probability-first mathematical foundations of classical ML and deep learning

### [Spring Boot Full Course](springboot/index.qmd)

- **ID:** `springboot`
- **Instructor:** Aditya Tandon (Coder Army)
- **Platform:** YouTube playlist
- **Focus:** Practice-first Spring Boot / Spring Framework notes — type code in your editor lecture by lecture

## Planned / next

When you start another series, create `courses/<id>/` and register it in `_quarto.yml`. Step-by-step: [Add a course](../docs/adding-a-course.qmd).
